jira.step1: Go to your Atlassian Security page: <anchor>API Tokens</anchor>.
jira.step3: Label your token (e.g., "Plan AI") and set an expiration date if needed.

linear.step1: Open Linear and navigate to Settings (click your profile icon or hit G then S).
linear.step2: Go to Account > Security & access in the sidebar.
linear.step3: Scroll down to Personal API keys and click New API key.
linear.step4: Label it "Plan AI" and hit Create. Copy your key immediately.

trello.step1: Go to the <anchor>Trello Power-Up Admin page</anchor>.
trello.step2: Click New to create a custom Power-Up app. Under Name, put "Plan AI Integration", select your workspace, accept the terms, and hit Create.
trello.step3: Copy the API Key displayed at the top of the page into our settings.
trello.step4: Click the Token link right below your API Key on the same page. Hit Allow on the next screen, and copy the token string from the blank page.

features.heading: What Plan AI does with your meetings
features.subheading: Recording, tickets, specs and a searchable memory of every decision. Built for software agencies and product engineering teams, and informed by your real code.

transcript.title: Bot-Free Recording
transcript.description: Native recorders for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android. No bot joins the call and nobody else sees the recorder. Works with Zoom, Meet, Teams and in-person meetings.

tasks.title: Real Jira & Linear Tickets
tasks.description: Not bullet points. Properly scoped tickets with acceptance criteria, story points, dependencies, and links to the exact files in your repo.

boards.title: Code-Aware Specs
boards.description: Plan AI reads your repo graph via GitNexus before writing a ticket. References real symbols, real files, real execution flows — no AI hallucinations.

slides.title: Sprint Review Decks
slides.description: Auto-generated decks from sprint demos and design reviews. Branded, exportable, client-ready in seconds — perfect for agency status updates.

chat.title: Codebase + Meeting RAG
chat.description: Ask 'why did we build it this way?' and get a real answer grounded in past standups, design reviews, and the current state of your code.

insights.title: BYOK or Managed
insights.description: Bring your own OpenRouter and Deepgram keys for €6/seat. Or let us handle the AI plumbing for €29/seat. No token taxes, no surprises.

howItWorks.heading: From standup to shipped ticket in 60 seconds

security.heading: Your meetings stay yours
security.subheading: Engineering meetings are full of client code and plans that are not public yet. Plan AI is built around keeping that material private.

ownServers.title: The AI can run on your servers
ownServers.description: With a private install, transcription, speaker identification, the language model and search all run on your own infrastructure. No meeting content goes to OpenAI, Deepgram or any other AI provider.

privateFiles.title: Private files, links that expire
privateFiles.description: Recordings, voice profiles and the files you upload are never public. Every read goes through a signed link that expires within 1 to 12 hours.

sharing.title: Nothing is shared by default
sharing.description: Meeting documents and slides stay inside your workspace. You share one on purpose, and you can stop sharing it at any moment. The link stops working straight away.

ownKeys.title: Your keys, your provider contracts
ownKeys.description: On the cloud version you can bring your own OpenRouter and Deepgram keys. The AI then runs under your own accounts and your own agreements with those providers.

audio.title: You decide how long audio stays
audio.description: Delete a meeting's audio and keep its notes, or let the workspace delete audio automatically after 7 to 365 days. Pause whenever you want, and tell the other people you are recording with one message.

encrypted.title: Encrypted keys and tokens
encrypted.description: Your AI keys and the tokens of connected tools are encrypted in the database, with the key kept outside it. Connecting a tool uses a signed request that expires in 10 minutes.

consent.title: Turn on your personal space
consent.what: Your personal space keeps private notes and trackers for things like food, weight, steps and habits.
consent.healthData: In the EU, food, weight and steps count as health data. To store them we need your explicit consent.
consent.private: This data is private to you. No owner or admin of any workspace can see it, and the assistant does not read it.
consent.ai: When a note is read with AI, the request uses your own OpenRouter key and asks for providers that keep no data.
consent.estimates: Calories are AI estimates, not medical or nutrition advice.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time in the trackers settings. That deletes all your trackers and entries.
consent.checkbox: I have read this and I agree to store my health data in my personal space.
consent.outdated: The text has changed since you last agreed. Please read it again.
consent.changedNow: The text changed while this window was open. Read it again and accept.
consent.failed: Could not turn on personal mode. Try again.

settings.title: Personal space settings
settings.hideCaloriesHelp: Calorie trackers show foods and grams, and whether you met the goal, without numbers.
settings.autoExtract: Read notes automatically when I leave them
settings.autoExtractHelp: When you leave a note you edited, the AI reads it and proposes entries. Nothing counts until you accept it.
settings.withdrawHelp: Withdrawing consent deletes all your trackers and entries. Your notes stay.
settings.withdraw: Withdraw consent and delete tracker data

withdraw.title: Withdraw consent?
withdraw.body: This deletes every tracker and every entry in them, including proposals waiting for review. It cannot be undone.
withdraw.notesStay: Your notes stay in your personal space. Delete them from Notes if you want them gone.
withdraw.done: Consent withdrawn. Your trackers and entries were deleted.

dailyReport.title: Daily report
dailyReport.subtitle: Say what you did today. The AI proposes changes to your tasks and nothing changes until you accept them.
dailyReport.loadError: Could not load the daily report. Try again.

personal.title: Not in a personal workspace
personal.body: The daily report is for team workspaces. Switch to a team workspace to use it.

off.title: The daily report is off
off.body: An owner or admin of this workspace can turn it on.
off.bodyManager: Turn it on below. Each member accepts the text before it runs for them.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.what: At the end of the day you write or dictate what you did. The AI reads it next to your open tasks and proposes changes: tasks done, moved forward or stuck, and new ones. Nothing changes until you accept it.
consent.who: The owners and admins of this workspace see your tasks and their status, as they already can in the projects, and how many days you sent a report. They never see the text or the audio of your report. It stays private to you.
consent.notRecorded: Nothing else is recorded: no screen, no keyboard, no location and no time in front of the computer.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw at any time from this page. Your waiting proposals are then deleted.
consent.withdrawConfirm: Stop using the daily report? Your waiting proposals are deleted. Tasks you already accepted stay as they are.
consent.withdrawn: You no longer use the daily report.

editor.hint: Plain words are enough. On the phone you can dictate it.
